title: Variance as a centered inner product
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance equals the uniform inner product of the centered function with itself: $\operatorname{Var}(f)=\langle f-\mathbb{E}f, f-\mathbb{E}f\rangle_u$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
